caption: The drawing features a single, brown, leather ankle boot positioned in profile facing left, centered on a plain, off-white background. The boot has a rounded toe, a low heel, and a slightly upward-curving sole at the front. There are six visible buttons along the side of the boot, arranged vertically and depicted as darker brown circles. Visible stitching details are illustrated on the upper part of the boot, and there are light and dark brown shading areas that give the boot a sense of three-dimensionality. The background does not contain any additional objects, textures, or marks, except for some faint text in the bottom right corner.
title: Shop Sign: Man's Shoe
